_: Furni lights the analysis cannot guess (tools/furni-lights.ts). layer: the letters of the layers that give light, when they are not additive; radius in tiles; intensity 0..1; spread: a light that faces the furni's front (0: the half in front, 0.7: a narrow cone); states: the states that give light (only the images their animations show); none: no light at all.
